ALTER VIEW [DW].[FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_View]
	AS 

WITH FactDep_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance as FDL
)

Select DEP.*
from DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance as DEP
    INNER JOIN FactDep_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = DEP.BusinessDateSK
